title: Dominic and the Cover
author: Ansel Villalobos
blurb: Orsen Marchetti, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
